publications.title: Lead Research Author — IEEE ICONICA 2026
publications.paperTitle: Comparative Analysis of Advanced CNN Architectures for Multi-Class Brain Tumor Classification Using MRI
publications.conference: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Next-Gen Intelligent Computing and Applications (ICONICA 2026)
publications.paperId: Paper ID: 597 | Track 2: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
publications.authors: Tisha Chhabra (First Author), Dr. Kamal Upreti, Dr. Varuna Gupta
publications.affiliation: Department of Computer Science, CHRIST (Deemed to be University), Bengaluru
highlights: First author of peer-reviewed research benchmarking advanced CNN backbones (EfficientNetV2, DenseNet121, ResNet50V2) for automated 4-class brain MRI diagnosis (Glioma, Meningioma, Pituitary, Normal Brain).
Attained premier benchmark performance with EfficientNetV2: 98.92% test accuracy, 0.9999 Macro-AUC, and the lowest misclassification rate across all tumor categories.
Demonstrated 100% specificity/recall on normal brain tissue, guaranteeing zero false-negative screenings on healthy individuals.
Implemented Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) to generate spatial heatmaps on convolutional feature maps, verifying visual explainability and clinical transparency.

Engineered unified classification head with dual global pooling (GAP + GMP concatenation), categorical label smoothing (0.10), cosine decay learning rate scheduling, and 8-fold Test-Time Augmentation (TTA).
